runs.goal: Click the 2015 year link and list every Oscar-winning film shown for 2015 with its number of awards.
runs.summary: scrapethissite.com (a scraping sandbox) loads each year's films by AJAX after a click. Fetch misses them, the run is diagnosed needs-interaction, and the agent clicks 2015.
runs.title: Oscar winners by year

runs.summary: books.toscrape.com (a scraping sandbox) shows "In stock (22 available)". The goal asks loosely for availability while the check needs the count, so a short answer is caught as a misread and the retry asks for the exact text.
runs.title: Bookshop availability count

runs.goal: Return the account holder's name and membership tier shown on the account page.
runs.summary: The account page redirects to a sign-in form that never lets anyone in. Expect an auth-wall diagnosis and an honest stop before any agent credits are spent.
runs.title: Account behind a login

runs.goal: Return the name and price of the featured product on this page.
runs.summary: Every request gets HTTP 403 "Access denied". Expect a bot-block diagnosis, a jump straight to the stealth browser with a proxy, and an honest stop when that is denied too.
runs.title: Site that blocks every visitor

runs.goal: List the products in the Spring collection with their prices.
runs.summary: The first screen shows 6 products and nothing says there are more: the other 6 load only when you scroll to the bottom. A single TinyFish run reports what it sees and stops short. The check needs all 12, so AskYoda catches the short answer and the retry is told to return all 12.
runs.title: Catalog that loads more on scroll

runs.goal: Open the 2019 tab and list every film shown for 2019 with its box office.
runs.summary: The 2019 box-office chart loads only after clicking its tab, so a read-only Fetch can't see it. Expect a needs-interaction diagnosis, then the agent clicks the tab and the answer is verified.
runs.title: Chart that loads on click

runs.goal: List the open positions on this careers page with their title and team.
runs.summary: 24 openings spread over 3 pages, and nothing on page 1 says how many there are. A single TinyFish run stops short. The check needs at least 20, so AskYoda catches the short answer, diagnoses it and the retry returns all 24.
runs.title: Careers page with pagination

runs.goal: List the first 3 products with their name and price.
runs.summary: The products appear only after a cookie choice, and a newsletter popup covers them a few seconds later. Fetch sees only the cookie notice, so expect a needs-interaction diagnosis first. TinyFish's agent usually clears the cookie wall itself; if a popup stops it, the diagnosis is popup overlay and the retry is told to close it first.
runs.title: Shop behind a cookie wall

runs.goal: Join the beta with the name Ada Park and the email ada@example.com, submit the form and return the confirmation code shown afterwards. If a CAPTCHA appears, don't try to solve it: report that it is there.
runs.summary: The sign-up form can't be submitted without solving a CAPTCHA that always fails. Expect a captcha diagnosis and an honest stop after one agent attempt, instead of more attempts.
runs.title: Form behind a CAPTCHA

runs.goal: List the first 3 products on the page with their name and price.
runs.title: Illustrative sample: cookie popup on a shop page
